front.title: Structured Action Requests and Shared Status in Email

abstract.t: Much email asks the recipient to do something: approve, send, sign, pay, decide. Email has no interoperable way to say who owns such a request, when it is due, or whether it is done, so senders track requests by hand and requests are dropped. This document defines a Structured Email (SML) profile for action requests: a machine- readable action object, carried as JSON-LD using the schema.org Action vocabulary and optionally mirrored as an iCalendar VTODO, plus status-update messages that supersede earlier ones, so that every participant's mail client in every administrative domain can show one current status. It works with no shared server between organizations, and it degrades to readable text in clients that do not implement it.
